story_log.title: Rays beat Guardians 3-1 in ALCS Game 5, take 3-2 series lead — one win from World Series
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 13, TIER 1 ELIMINATION-ROUND GAME]: Tampa Bay beat Cleveland 3-1 per ground truth. Rays lead series 3-2, Game 6 Monday at Tropicana Field. Tampa Bay one win from reaching World Series for first time since 2020. Drew Rasmussen: 7.0 IP, 4 H, 1 ER, 2 BB, 6 SO per TalkinBaseball. Liam Hicks 2-RBI single in 5th gave Rays 2-0 lead per TalkinBaseball. Chandler Simpson scored on Ben Williamson single in 5th per TalkinBaseball. Chase DeLauter RBI groundout in 6th cut lead to 2-1 per TalkinBaseball. Tyler Wells entered in 8th with Jose Ramirez due up as tying run per TalkinBaseball — got inning-ending double play instead of challenging for strike three per TalkinBaseball. Steven Kwan defensive highlights throughout night per TalkinBaseball.

story_log.title: Packers beat Cowboys 23-13 on SNF — Jordan Love 2 total TD, Dallas drops to 2-4 with back-to-back losses
story_log.development: Green Bay beat Dallas 23-13 per ground truth. Cowboys now 2-4 after 6 games, last start this bad or worse 2020 per ground truth. Jordan Love: 23-41, 288 total YDS, 2 total TD, 1 INT per ClutchPoints. Matthew Golden: 6 REC, 104 YDS, 1 TD per StatMuse — two straight games with 100+ receiving yards per StatMuse. Cowboys lost to Packers for first time since 2022-11-13 per ground truth. Three roughing-the-passer penalties on Dak Prescott drew controversy per ClutchPoints — Carrington Valentine INT overturned on roughing call per ClutchPoints/HaterReport. Packers 4-2, tied for 2nd in NFC North per ground truth. Dallas 2-4, 3rd in NFC East per ground truth.

story_log.title: Ben Simmons suffers torn Achilles at Kings practice — season-ending injury days before opener
story_log.development: Simmons tore Achilles tendon at practice Sunday per CBS Sports/NBAMemes — season-ending injury per CBS Sports. Didn't play during 2025-26 season, was expected to start for Sacramento this year per CBS Sports. Former No. 1 pick's comeback attempt ends before it began. ClutchPoints: 'You have to feel bad for Ben Simmons... because his body gave up on him after trying to make a comeback in the league.' Kings lose starting guard before season opener.

story_log.title: Thunder extend Cason Wallace on 5-year, $139M deal — setting up another summer of second apron questions
story_log.development: Oklahoma City signed Wallace to 5yr/$139M rookie-scale extension per CBS Sports/ShamsCharania. Locking up Wallace follows offseason of moves intended to shed payroll and duck under second apron per CBS Sports. Thunder's depth and payroll management under spotlight. Deal sets up more luxury tax questions next summer.

story_log.title: Josh Allen throws unbelievable backhanded TD pass vs Raiders — channels Brett Favre on extraordinary improvisation
story_log.development: Allen avoided potential sack and improvised extraordinary backhanded touchdown pass per CBS Sports/AdamSchefter — immediately drew comparisons to legendary Brett Favre play per CBS Sports. Buffalo beat Las Vegas 33-30 per ground truth. James Cook: 25 touches, 153 total YDS, 1 total TD per StatMuse — five straight games with rushing TD per StatMuse. Allen's play already viral.

story_log.title: Bills S C.J. Gardner-Johnson ejected for spitting at Raiders TE Brock Bowers — NFL reviewing for discipline
story_log.development: Gardner-Johnson ejected after cameras captured him spitting at Bowers per AdamSchefter/SharpFootball. NFL reviewing disqualification for potential additional discipline per AdamSchefter. Gardner-Johnson apologized on Instagram per AdamSchefter. Any disqualification always reviewed for potential additional discipline. Bills won 33-30 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Browns take first place in AFC North after beating Ravens 13-10 — latest they've led division since Week 10 in 2014
story_log.development: Cleveland beat Baltimore 13-10 per ground truth. Browns now 4-2, 1st in AFC North (tied on record, provisional 3+ team tie) per ground truth. Latest they've been first in division since Week 10 in 2014 per StatMuse/AlbertBreer. Ravens fall to 4-2, 3rd in AFC North per ground truth. Cleveland leads division this late for first time in 12 years.

story_log.title: Steelers rally from 13 down in 4th to beat Bucs 26-19 in OT — Jalen Ramsey game-winning sack, Chris Boswell two 58-yard FGs
story_log.development: Pittsburgh beat Tampa Bay 26-19 in OT per ground truth. Steelers down 13 in 4th quarter, rallied back per ESPN. Boswell: two 58-yard FGs per AlbertBreer — first after FG lost track of game clock, second to pull even per AlbertBreer. Ramsey: 10 TKL, 4 TFL, 2 SACK per StatMuse — game-winning sack in OT per StatMuse/ESPN. Steelers improve to 4-2 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Chargers fall to 0-6 after loss to Chiefs — franchise's first 0-6 start since 2000
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 6]: Kansas City beat LA 22-6 per ground truth. Chargers now 0-6 after 6 games, last start this bad or worse 2000 per ground truth. 6 straight losses this season, last 6+ within a season 2015 per ground truth. Coming into bye at 0-6 with at Rams, vs Texans, at Ravens after per AlbertBreer. Herbert continues to struggle. Harbaugh's seat getting hotter.

story_log.title: Cardinals upset Rams 18-16 — Chad Ryland punter kicks PAT to give LA lead, Arizona wins on FG
story_log.development: Arizona beat LA 18-16 per ground truth. Rams punter Ethan Evans kicked PAT to give Rams lead after kicker Blake Grupe hurt knee per AlbertBreer/PatMcAfeeShow — was pure per AlbertBreer. Ryland kicked game-winning FG for Cardinals per PatMcAfeeShow/SportsCenter. Controversial roughing call on Josh Wallace late per AlbertBreer. Rams fall to 2-4, last place in NFC West per ground truth. Cardinals 2-4, tied with Rams per ground truth.

story_log.title: Titans get first win of season 26-20 over Colts — previously 0-5 Tennessee ends drought
story_log.development: Tennessee beat Indianapolis 26-20 per ground truth. Titans were 0-5 entering game, get first win per SportsCenter. Beat Colts for first time since 2022-10-23 per ground truth, won at Indianapolis for first time since 2022-10-02 per ground truth. Tennessee now 1-5, Colts 2-4 per ground truth. Colts blew 13-0 lead per CBS Sports.

story_log.title: Panthers beat Eagles 25-14 — Carolina improves to 3-2, Philadelphia drops to 2-4 after 4-game losing streak
story_log.development: Carolina beat Philadelphia 25-14 per ground truth. Panthers now 3-2 after 5 games, last start this good or better 2021 per ground truth. Beat Eagles for first time since 2018-10-21 per ground truth, won at Philadelphia for first time since 2018-10-21 per ground truth. Eagles now 2-4 after 6 games, last start this bad or worse 2021 per ground truth. 4 straight losses this season, last 4+ within a season 2020 per ground truth. Chuba Hubbard continues strong season.

story_log.title: Bears beat Falcons 31-23 — Caleb Williams returns, Chicago improves to 4-2
story_log.development: Chicago beat Atlanta 31-23 per ground truth. Bears now 4-2, tied for 3rd in NFC North per ground truth. Williams back from injury per AdamSchefter — Ben Johnson victory speeches return per AdamSchefter. D'Andre Swift: 20 touches, 70 total YDS, 2 total TD per StatMuse. Falcons fall to 2-4 per ground truth, now 2-4 after 6 games (last start this bad or worse 2020) per ground truth.

story_log.title: Texans beat Jaguars 34-31 to improve to 2-4 — CJ Stroud having excellent season despite record
story_log.development: Houston beat Jacksonville 34-31 per ground truth. Texans now 2-4 per ground truth. Stroud: 96.9 Total QBR per BillBarnwell — second-best performance by any QB this season behind Brock Purdy's Week 2 game per BillBarnwell. AlbertBreer: With struggling run game, Stroud playing really good ball all year. Jaguars fall to 4-2 per ground truth.

story_log.title: Saints beat Giants 34-27 — JJ McCarthy sparks NY comeback attempt, Cam Skattebo zero touches
story_log.development: New Orleans beat NY 34-27 per ground truth. McCarthy gave Giants spark after entering game per AlbertBreer/BillBarnwell. Skattebo: 0 touches per SportsCenter/BillBarnwell — Giants RB snaps: Devin Singletary 14, Tyrone Tracy 13, Najee Harris 11, Skattebo 6 per BillBarnwell. Saints improve to 2-4 per ground truth. Giants 3-2-1, still 1st in NFC East per ground truth.

story_log.title: Patriots beat Jets 26-19 — Drake Maye 3 TD passes, New England improves to 4-2
story_log.development: New England beat NY 26-19 per ground truth. Maye: 18-32, 235 YDS, 3 TD, 0 INT per StatMuse — three straight games with 3+ TD passes per StatMuse. Patriots now 4-2, 2nd in AFC East per ground truth. Jets fall to 2-4 per ground truth. New England beat Jets for first time since 2022 per recent history.

story_log.title: Wild beat Blue Jackets 2-1 in NHL action
story_log.development: Minnesota beat Columbus 2-1 per ground truth. Wild improve. Blue Jackets fall. Regular season continues.

story_log.title: Flames beat Hurricanes 3-2 — Calgary upsets defending champs
story_log.development: Calgary beat Carolina 3-2 per ground truth. Flames upset defending Stanley Cup champions. Hurricanes fall. Regular season continues.

story_log.title: Orioles hire Jared Banner as general manager — former Cubs assistant GM joins Mike Elias in Baltimore
story_log.development: Baltimore hired Banner as general manager per JeffPassan. Banner was assistant GM with Cubs, joins Elias in Orioles leadership per JeffPassan. Nearly two decades working executive jobs with Cubs, Mets and Red Sox per JeffPassan. Baltimore adds front office piece.

lead_story.headline: Rays 3, Guardians 1 — Tampa Bay one win from World Series

lead_story.research_notes:
CONTINUING [Day 13]: Reader knows this is an ALCS, knows both teams, knows Rays were down 0-2 and came back. Today's new development is Tampa Bay won Game 5 3-1 and now leads series 3-2. Skip the backstory. Lead with what changed: Rays are one win from the World Series for the first time since 2020 (per ground truth).

Drew Rasmussen: 7.0 IP, held Guardians to just one run — continues stellar postseason run (career 2.41 postseason ERA per recent history, first run given up after 13 scoreless innings per Oct 13 history).

Liam Hicks 2-RBI single in 5th gave Rays 2-0 lead. Chandler Simpson scored on Ben Williamson single in 5th to extend lead to 3-0. Chase DeLauter RBI groundout in 6th cut lead to 3-1.

Tyler Wells entered in 8th with Jose Ramirez due up as tying run with two outs — got inning-ending double play instead of challenging for strike three. Steven Kwan defensive highlights throughout night (multiple clips from TalkinBaseball).

Game 6 Monday at Tropicana Field. Rays can clinch at home. Guardians facing elimination again, need to win two straight to advance.

Cross-sport irony: the Rays — 98M payroll per Oct 16 history — are one win from the World Series. The small-market underdog story continues. Contrast with Dodgers' billion-dollar payroll getting swept by Brewers.

Historical parallel: this would be Rays' first World Series appearance since 2020 (lost to Dodgers). Brewers await winner — also a small-market team (143.5M payroll per Oct 16 history). David vs. Goliath World Series incoming?
